rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday term for a very strong wind, including a gale.

example.english: There’s a gale blowing outside, so be careful when you go out.
example.traditional: 出面刮緊大風，行出去要小心。
example.jyutping: ceot1 min6 gwaat3 gan2 daai6 fung1 haang4 ceot1 heoi3 jiu3 siu2 sam1

rows.note: Use this for a sudden, loud burst of laughter rather than for wind.

example.english: After they said that, the whole group burst into a gale of laughter.
example.traditional: 佢講完呢句，成班人即刻爆出一陣狂笑。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 jyun4 ne1 geoi3 sing4 baan1 jan4 zik1 hak1 baau3 ceot1 jat1 zan6 kwong4 siu3
